# MOVEGO

> MOVEGO (full name: MOVEGO: Immersive Workout) is a cardio game for iPhone. You prop up the phone, step back, and your body is the controller: jump, duck, step left, step right, punch and strike a pose to dodge obstacles and collect coins. The front camera tracks your moves on the phone. Camera images are never uploaded or saved. Made by Dao Duc Thang.

Key facts: iPhone only (iOS 16.4 or later), rated 12+, free to start, optional MOVEGO Plus subscription, English. App Store Connect app id 6777393163. Website: https://movegoimmersiveworkout.app/
